Questions before you join

Is VANTRO100 still working?

Yes. We checked the code on 29 Oct 2026. It is valid until 31 Dec 2026 for new customers.

What does 1× wagering mean?

You need to bet the bonus amount once before winnings from it can be withdrawn. Free bet stakes are not returned.

Can I use an e-wallet for the deposit?

No. Deposits by e-wallet do not qualify. Use a debit card, bank transfer or Apple Pay.

I forgot to enter the code. What now?

Contact Vantro support within 7 days of registering; they can add the offer if you have not placed a bet yet.

Can I set limits before I play?

Yes. You can set deposit limits during sign-up and change them in your account at any time.
